(235)༄༅/ /sgom po lugs kyi phyag chen dang chos drug zung 'brel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs 'pho ba'i gseng lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (235)༄༅// sgom po lugs kyi phyag chen dang chos drug zung 'brel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs 'pho ba'i gseng lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(236)༄༅// rigs kun bdag nyid bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal ba'i yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gsang bdag sprul pa byang sems bde ba'i mgon// snying po'i rtsa brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grub chen gtso bo dpal ldan sa ra ha// rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs// gnyug ma'i don rtogs rje btsun sha ba ri// phyag chen brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// chos kun sgyu mar gzigs pa'i dpal ldan mtshan// rgyal sras 'phags pa lha dang zla ba grags// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i ma taṃ gi /bskyed rim sgyu lus brgyud la gsol ba 'debs// dngos grub gnyis brnyes grub chen lū hi pa// dpa' bo ḍeṃ gi pa dang dha ri ka /mchog gi rnal 'byor su kha dha ri'i zhabs// thabs lam gtum mo'i brgyud la= /spyod mdzad ḍom+bi pa dang bī na sa// 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa'i lwa wa pa// de bzhin nyid gzigs in+d+ra bhū ti'i zhabs// rmi lam 'od gsal brgyud la= /lhan skyes don rtogs rnal 'byor su kha si// sna tshogs sprul pa ston pa'i thang lo pa// (237)don gzigs shing lo pa dang kar+ṇa ri// bar do 'pho ba'i brgyud la= /bka' babs yongs rdzogs sprul sku tai lo pa// thub bstan gsal mdzad mkhas grub nā ro'i zhabs// snying po'i lam ston a wa dhū ti pa// grub pa'i dbang po rnams la= /gdams pa kun gyi brgyud 'dzin mar pa'i zhabs// grub pa'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor mi la rje// snying po'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad sgam po pa// sgrub brgyud gtsug rgyan rnams la= /bdag nyid chen po sgom pa tshul khrims rje// de nyid don gzigs shes rab dbang phyug zhabs// mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid mkhan chen 'dul 'dzin pa// bstan pa'i rtsa lag rnams la= /lung rtogs mnga' bdag dpal ldan la yag pa// bslab gsum nor 'dzin mkhan chen bye kar pa// snang srid chos skur rtogs pa'i snyi sgom rje// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rnams la=

/phrin las dbang phyug shes rab 'byung gnas mtshan// mkhyen rab spyan dang ldan pa'i chos gling pa// kun gyi gtsug rgyan chos kyi tshul khrims zhabs// mthu stobs bdag nyid rnams la= /mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan lha lung pa// (238)byang chub sems dpa' mkhan chen lha btsun zhabs// 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam pa jo sras rje// thar 'dod ded dpon rnams la= /tshogs gnyis dbang 'byor chos kyi rgyal mtshan rje// sprul pa'i sku mchog dam pa chos seng pa// grub pa mchog brnyes chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs// bstan pa'i sgron me rnams la= /sgrub pa lhur mdzad rnal 'byor rin rdor pa// mkhyen gzigs mnga' ba bsod nams rin chen mtshan// mkhas btsun dam pa mkhan chen rgyal mtshan bzang*// thar pa'i lam ston rnams la= /don gnyis mthar phyin bsod nams rgya mtsho dang*// gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin mkhan chen shākya'i mtshan// snying po'i don gzigs bsod nams lhun grub zhabs// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams la= /rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus maṅga laṃ// grub brnyes mchog gzigs bkra shis chos 'byor rje// 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog nor bu rgyan pa'i zhabs// bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan rnams la= /mkhas mchog spyan snga rin chen rdo rje dang*// grub pa'i skyes mchog bzang po rdo rje'i zhabs// rje btsun bla ma lhun grub nges don dbang*// bstan pa'i snang byed rnams la= /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin dam chos dbang phyug dang*// bstan pa'i gsal byed bstan pa dar rgyas mtshan// grub pa'i dbang phyug byang chub rdo rje ste// zab lam spel mdzad rnams la= /sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin kun dga' snying po'i zhabs// rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas dpal// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la= /byin rlabs 'byung gnas sgrub brgyud bla ma dang*// dngos grub kun rtsol yi dam lha yi tshogs// bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// sgrub pa'i stong grogs rnams la=

/de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje yis// bde drod gtum mo'i rtogs pa mthar phyin nas// srog rtsol gnad tshud ye shes 'char ba dang*// ro snyoms sgyu lus 'byong par byin (239)gyis rlobs// rmi lam bag chags ma 'khrul sprul sgyur rtsal// 'byongs nas chos rnams de ltar rtogs pa dang*// gnyid 'thug snang med gti mug lam longs nas// spros bral 'od gsal zin par byin gyis rlobs// srid pa bar do gsum du sku gsum gyi// rang ngo shes nas rang dbang thob pa dang*// gang du 'pho yang 'khor ba'i sgo khegs nas// rlung sems rtsal du thon par byin gyis rlobs// spros pa'i rnam rtog zab mo'i gnad kyis ni// tha mal shes pa rang ngo mthong ba dang*// spang blang med pa gnyug ma'i gnad mchog gis// snang srid chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// yang dag snying po'i don la yid ches nas// chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan sgam po pa'i// sgrub brgyud dri ma med par 'dzin gyur cig// /maṅga laṃ// (240)
